sources.snippet: ⚠️ Reachy Mini is still in beta. Expect bugs, some of them we won't fix right away if they are not a priority. Reachy Mini is an expressive, open-source robot designed for human-robot interaction, creative coding, and AI experimentation. We made it to be affordable, easy to use, hackable and cute, so that you can focus on building cool AI applications!

sources.title: Reachy Mini - Open-Source Desktop Humanoid Robot | Build AI Applications
sources.snippet: Reachy Mini is an open-source desktop humanoid robot designed for AI experimentation, education, and research. It's perfect for developers learning robotics, educators teaching AI concepts, researchers exploring human-robot interaction, and hobbyists interested in building interactive applications.
